title: DOBAR: Domain Ontology Construction and Reasoning Method Combined with Large Language Models - Reproducibility Package
description:
Research artifact accompanying the manuscript DOBAR: A Domain Ontology Construction and Reasoning Method Combined with Large Language Models submitted to Data & Knowledge Engineering (Elsevier).

The archive contains: (i) the prototype system implementing change-data-capture driven ontology updating, ontology quality management, and ontology-augmented reasoning (Flask backend, Vue 3 frontend); (ii) data/test1.sql, the MySQL dump of the simulated domain relational database (12 tables, 5,512 structured records) together with the 132-document news corpus (43,758 characters) used in Section 5.1; and (iii) the scripts that build the knowledge graph and reproduce the experiments of Section 5.

KQAPro and CMNEE are third-party datasets that are not redistributed here; the import scripts download or expect them from their official releases.
